blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The 55-year-old driver who fell from a fourth floor parking building along Jimenez Street in Barangay San Lorenzo, Makati City was only a reliever the day of the incident, the Southern Police District (SPD) disclosed. SPD Public Information Officer PLt. Margaret Panaga said that the driver picked up the vehicle parked inside the building around 11:46 a.m. to pick up someone on Thursday, Nov. 26.
